name: Describing Taste & Flavor
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on describing taste & flavor — practice these key phrases out loud:
This soup is a little too salty for me.
It has a nice, sweet aftertaste.
This bread is so fresh and fluffy.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
